name: JADO

dials.resolution: Explicit request > valid checkpoint > project instructions line 'JADO defaults: stage=… involvement=… budget=…' > the defaults below. Announce the resolved dials in one line before work starts. The user can change any dial mid-run, for example 'jado: autopilot' or 'jado: lean'.

explore.purpose: Find a direction fast: many divergent options, low fidelity, user taste decides.
explore.fidelity: Real content and structure; rough type, color and spacing. Polish waits for refine.
explore.selfCheck: One capture per artboard after building it; fix only broken text, clipping, overlapping nodes or missing content.

refine.purpose: Mature the selected direction: hierarchy, states, consistency and craft.
refine.fidelity: Project tokens and components where they exist; relevant states covered.
refine.selfCheck: jado-canvas-verify or browser check on the final revision of each changed surface.
refine.independentReview: when budget is normal or deep

ship.purpose: Production quality: fidelity, accessibility, behavior and regressions.
ship.fidelity: Production: tokens, components, responsive behavior, accessibility and edge states.
ship.selfCheck: Full applicable checks on the final revision.

values.autopilot: Run without questions. Decide taste and direction within scope, log each choice with its alternatives in the decision log, mark user-owned choices provisional and present them at delivery. Stop only for irreversible actions, scope or authorization expansion, or missing access.
values.checkpoints: Ask at checkpoints only: an open direction-changing decision after framing, variant selection, and before advancing stage or starting code. Ask in one round of at most four questions; decide and log everything else.
values.pair: Ask before each taste or direction decision and show intermediate results. Batch related questions into one round, each answerable in a click.

lean.note: The single delegation is reserved for an independent review that the stage requires.

fast.use: Generators in explore, and every agent on a lean budget.

default.use: The profile's own model and effort.

strong.use: Generators and reviewers on a deep budget.

modelTiers.apply: Pass the tier as the delegation call's model override when the tool supports one (Claude Code Agent tool: model); otherwise continue with the profile default.

rules: The effective budget is the lower of the budget dial and the route cap. A stage-required review takes precedence over a lean budget unless the user waives it.
A fix pass is one batch of edits, one fresh capture and one check. Each artifact gets the stage's maxFixPasses; at the cap, deliver with the remaining issues listed.
Capture after each visual group and once at the end. Review each changed revision once per repair batch.
Only the primary agent asks the user. Facts are the agent's job; decisions are the user's. Delegated agents return questions with a recommended default and continue on it when it is reversible.
Use one writer per shared artifact; default to one writer per Paper document.
Use VariantHub only on explicit request.
Required checks pass only with current-revision evidence; the stage decides which checks are required, and an independent review runs in a context distinct from the author.
The primary agent coordinates and may author. Delegate for context isolation, permissions or independent judgment.
Deployment, merging, global configuration and method changes need authorization beyond a design assignment.
Load the index and only the selected route packet; read a skill only when its condition applies.
runtimeEnforcement: cooperative; graph guards are validated at compile time, runtime behavior follows instructions
